title.zh: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
title.en: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum

current_state.zh: Amundi launched a tokenized share class of its STOXX Europe 600 equity index fund on Ethereum, built with CACEIS infrastructure, as it expands blockchain-based offerings beyond money market funds and targets institutional and digital-platform distribution.
